summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed Form 6-K disclosing completion of its acquisition of an additional 2% stake in subsidiary ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited (ICICI Life). The acquisition was executed through multiple stock-exchange tranches between July 22 and September 2, 2026, totaling 29,015,693 shares at an approximate consideration of INR 14.70 billion. Following the purchase, ICICI Bank's shareholding in ICICI Life rose to approximately 52.8%. This is an open-market creeping acquisition, not a tender offer, with no premium or board recommendation disclosed. Watch for further stake increases and regulatory thresholds under Indian listing rules.
